metadata.title: A possible physical connection between helium-rich stellar populations of massive globular clusters and the UV upturn of galactic spheroids

notes: No eligible stars. The paper discusses stellar populations, star clusters, and galaxies, but identifies no individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate or as a previously identified Galactic unbound candidate. Its uses of “unbound” refer to star clusters rather than stars escaping the Milky Way (T:p2-b10); the named objects ω Cen and NGC 2808 are globular clusters, not individual stars (T:p1-b7).
